scope.summary: Repository-wide static security review of tracked application source, Supabase functions and migrations, deployment configuration, and security-sensitive client flows.

assumptions: Tracked Supabase migrations represent the production policy state
Configured JWT verification is enabled for functions marked verify_jwt=true
Public anonymous keys are available to browser users by design
attackerCapabilities: Unauthenticated requests using the public project credentials
Suspended administrator retaining an unexpired session
securityObjectives: Enforce suspension and role authorization server-side

Edge Function to Paystack and Resend
